summary: The cadets try to carry Eren out of Trost. His missing arm is the question they cannot answer, until the Survey Corps cuts a path.

segments.ja: 本部の屋根から、エレンは人の形のまま下ろされます。下ろされた体は熱く、欠けた左腕の断面はまだ閉じていません。閉じていない腕を、ミカサは布で押さえます。押さえるあいだ、アルミンは通りの巨人の数を数えます。数える街は、まだ穴の開いたトロストです。開いた街から出るには、ガスの戻った翼でも人が足りません。足りない班が、エレンを中心に輪を作ります。作る輪は、逃げの隊形です。
segments.en: From the roof of headquarters, Eren is lowered still in a human shape. The lowered body is hot, and the cut end of the missing left arm has not closed yet. Mikasa presses cloth to the arm that has not closed. While she presses it, Armin counts the Titans in the street. The town he counts is still Trost with a hole in it. To leave the open town, even wings with gas restored do not have enough people. The short-handed squad makes a circle with Eren at the center. The circle they make is a formation for flight.

segments.ja: ジャンは、欠けた肩を見て質問を一つ持ちます。持つ質問は、巨人の中にいたとき、その腕はあったのか、です。あったように見えた肉が、今は人間の傷に戻っています。戻った矛盾を、誰も医学では説明しません。説明しないまま、彼らは走ります。走る理由は、謎より先に、次の角の巨人が来る、です。来る足音を、コニーが屋根の上から知らせます。知らせるたびに、輪は細くなります。
segments.en: Jean looks at the missing shoulder and holds one question. The question he holds is whether the arm was there when Eren was inside the Titan. Flesh that looked present has returned now to a human wound. Nobody explains the returned contradiction with medicine. Without explaining it, they run. The reason they run is that, ahead of the mystery, a Titan is coming at the next corner. Connie signals the approaching footsteps from a roof. Each time he signals, the circle grows thinner.

segments.titleEn: He cannot become a Titan again
segments.ja: 通りが塞がると、アルミンはエレンに、もう一度あの体になってくれと頼みます。頼む相手は、まだ半分眠っています。眠っている口は、やってみると答えます。答えた体から蒸気は出ますが、巨人の骨格は完成しません。完成しない失敗が、輪の希望を一度折ります。折れる音を、ミカサは聞きながら刃を構えます。構える刃は、巨人一体を切るには足りても、道を空けるには足りません。足りない空が、本部の後ろに残ります。
segments.en: When the street is blocked, Armin asks Eren to become that body once more. The person he asks is still half asleep. The sleeping mouth answers that he will try. Steam comes from the body that answered, but a Titan's frame does not finish. The failure that does not finish breaks the circle's hope once. Mikasa hears the sound of the break and readies a blade. The blade she readies is enough to cut one Titan, and not enough to clear a road. The insufficient sky stays behind headquarters.

segments.ja: 失敗のあと、ミカサはエレンを背中の班に預け、自分は先頭へ出ます。出る理由は、左腕の謎を今は戦いで遅らせる、です。遅らせる飛び方は、一位の精度を戻します。戻した刃が、近い巨人の指を払います。払っても、次の体がすぐ通りを埋めます。埋める速度に、ガスは再び減り始めます。減り始める計算を、アルミンが声にします。する声は、このままでは壁に着く前に落ちる、です。
segments.en: After the failure, Mikasa leaves Eren with the squad at her back and goes to the front herself. The reason she goes is to postpone the mystery of the left arm inside the fight. The way of flying that postpones it restores the precision of first place. The restored blade sweeps the fingers of a near Titan. Even after the sweep, the next body fills the street at once. Against the speed of the filling, the gas begins to decrease again. Armin puts the calculation of the decrease into a voice. The voice he puts is: like this, we fall before we reach the wall.

segments.titleEn: The left arm does not return
segments.ja: 安全な屋根に着いても、エレンの左腕は生えてきません。きません。巨人の体では肉があった側が、人間に戻ると欠けるままです。ままの欠落を、リヴァイは戦闘のあとで一度見ます。見る目は、同情よりも記録です。記録する質問は、その力は腕と一緒に消えたのか、です。のか、に、エレンは答えられません。答えられないことが、この回の題です。題は、行方です。行方は、まだ誰の手の中にもありません。
segments.en: Even after they reach a safer roof, Eren's left arm does not grow back. It does not. The side that had flesh in the Titan body stays missing when he returns to human. After the fight, Levi looks once at the lack that stays. The eyes that look are a record more than sympathy. The question he records is whether that power vanished together with the arm. Eren cannot answer the whether. Not being able to answer is the title of this episode. The title is whereabouts. The whereabouts are not yet in anyone's hand.

segments.titleEn: Jean looks at the wings again
segments.ja: ジャンは、調査兵団の刃を見たあと、自分の十位の希望を一度黙ります。黙る理由は、内側の安全が、この通りでは何も切らなかった、です。切らなかった自分を、彼は責めつつ、まだ翼には入りたくないとも思っています。思っている矛盾を、今日は口にしません。口にしない横で、彼はエレンの欠けた肩に水を渡します。渡す動作が、同期の残り方です。残り方は、信じることとは別です。別のまま、彼は隣にいます。
segments.en: After seeing the Survey Corps' blades, Jean goes quiet once about his hope of tenth place. The reason he goes quiet is that safety inside cut nothing on this street. He blames the self that cut nothing, and he still thinks he does not want to join the wings. He does not put the contradiction he thinks into his mouth today. Beside the not putting it, he passes water to Eren's missing shoulder. The motion of passing is how a classmate remains. How he remains is separate from believing. Still separate, he stays beside him.

segments.ja: アルミンは、巨人になれなかった数秒を、次の図の材料にします。する材料は、頼んでも体はすぐには答えない、です。答えない力は、武器として未完成です。未完成のまま、調査兵団はそれを回収しました。回収した意味を、彼は壁の上の会議に持っていきます。持っていく前に、彼はエレンの熱が下がるのを待ちます。待つあいだ、ミカサが脈を見ます。見る脈は、続いています。続いていれば、失敗は死ではありません。
segments.en: Armin makes the few seconds of failing to become a Titan into material for the next diagram. The material he makes is that even if you ask, the body does not answer at once. A power that does not answer is unfinished as a weapon. Still unfinished, the Survey Corps recovered it. He will take the meaning of the recovery to the meeting on the wall. Before he takes it, he waits for Eren's heat to fall. While he waits, Mikasa watches the pulse. The pulse she watches is continuing. If it continues, the failure is not death.

segments.en: Even after the Survey Corps clears a road, the whole of Trost has not returned. Titans are still coming in through the hole that has not returned. The district they come into and the district people evacuated split the town in half. Wings now line up on the border of the half. The work of the lined-up wings is to deliver Eren onto the wall. Inside the procession that delivers him, the recruits see the Survey Corps' backs from close for the first time. The backs they see are narrow. The narrow backs made today's escape hold.

Still unknown, they head up the wall. The question that heads up is the next response. The response is whether to shoot him or use him.

vocab.exampleJa: 閉じていない腕を、ミカサは布で押さえます。
vocab.exampleEn: From the roof of headquarters, Eren is lowered still in a human shape. The lowered body is hot, and the cut end of the missing left arm has not closed yet. Mikasa presses cloth to the arm that has not closed. While she presses it, Armin counts the Titans in the street. The town he counts is still Trost with a hole in it. To leave the open town, even wings with gas restored do not have enough people. The short-handed squad makes a circle with Eren at the center. The circle they make is a formation for flight.

vocab.exampleJa: 戻した刃が、近い巨人の指を払います。
vocab.exampleEn: After the failure, Mikasa leaves Eren with the squad at her back and goes to the front herself. The reason she goes is to postpone the mystery of the left arm inside the fight. vocab.exampleJa: 半分の境界に、今は翼が並びます。
vocab.exampleEn: Even after the Survey Corps clears a road, the whole of Trost has not returned. Titans are still coming in through the hole that has not returned. The district they come into and the district people evacuated split the town in half. Wings now line up on the border of the half. The work of the lined-up wings is to deliver Eren onto the wall. Inside the procession that delivers him, the recruits see the Survey Corps' backs from close for the first time. The backs they see are narrow. The narrow backs made today's escape hold.

vocab.exampleEn: The whereabouts of the left arm are not on the ground. In place of having fallen, it appeared once inside the Titan and vanished when he returned to human. Levi makes the vanished fact into a short report. The report he makes is: the subject is alive, the power is unstable, the arm is missing. The three words of the missing part prepare the next question on the wall. The question they prepare is whether to shoot this human or use him. This episode of the escape does not yet decide the whether. Without deciding, they climb the ladder.

vocab.exampleJa: 待つあいだ、ミカサが脈を見ます。
vocab.exampleEn: Armin makes the few seconds of failing to become a Titan into material for the next diagram. The material he makes is that even if you ask, the body does not answer at once. A power that does not answer is unfinished as a weapon. Still unfinished, the Survey Corps recovered it. He will take the meaning of the recovery to the meeting on the wall. Before he takes it, he waits for Eren's heat to fall. While he waits, Mikasa watches the pulse. The pulse she watches is continuing. If it continues, the failure is not death.

vocab.exampleJa: 頼む相手は、まだ半分眠っています。
vocab.exampleEn: When the street is blocked, Armin asks Eren to become that body once more. The person he asks is still half asleep. The sleeping mouth answers that he will try. Steam comes from the body that answered, but a Titan's frame does not finish. The failure that does not finish breaks the circle's hope once. Mikasa hears the sound of the break and readies a blade. The blade she readies is enough to cut one Titan, and not enough to clear a road. The insufficient sky stays behind headquarters.

vocab.exampleJa: 拒否の理由は、隠すと、この傷がなかったことになる、です。
vocab.exampleEn: In front of the ladder to the wall, someone says to hide the missing arm with cloth. The reason they say it is that the soldiers above will be startled. Mikasa refuses the being startled. The reason for the refusal is that if they hide it, the wound becomes something that was not there. She does not put down that lie. With the arm not put down, Eren is carried up. The figure that is carried is not a hero and not a monster. He is an injured person. The top of the wall sees next that the injured person's left side is empty.

vocab.exampleJa: 戻った矛盾を、誰も医学では説明しません。
vocab.exampleEn: Jean looks at the missing shoulder and holds one question. The question he holds is whether the arm was there when Eren was inside the Titan. Flesh that looked present has returned now to a human wound. Nobody explains the returned contradiction with medicine. Without explaining it, they run. The reason they run is that, ahead of the mystery, a Titan is coming at the next corner. Connie signals the approaching footsteps from a roof. Each time he signals, the circle grows thinner.

vocab.exampleJa: 巨人の中の人間を、回収する命令があったのです。
vocab.exampleEn: At the edge of the street, one soldier briefly says Erwin's name. The content he says is that the Commander is watching this withdrawal from the wall. The judgment of watching means they will not leave the recruits behind at headquarters. Armin receives the meaning like a map. On the map he receives, the Survey Corps did not come by accident. They did not. There was an order to recover the human inside the Titan. Eren cannot yet hear the order that was there. The body that cannot hear it is carried between the wings.

vocab.exampleJa: ジャンは、調査兵団の刃を見たあと、自分の十位の希望を一度黙ります。
vocab.exampleEn: After seeing the Survey Corps' blades, Jean goes quiet once about his hope of tenth place. The reason he goes quiet is that safety inside cut nothing on this street. He blames the self that cut nothing, and he still thinks he does not want to join the wings. He does not put the contradiction he thinks into his mouth today. Beside the not putting it, he passes water to Eren's missing shoulder. The motion of passing is how a classmate remains. How he remains is separate from believing. Still separate, he stays beside him.

vocab.exampleJa: 抜く動きを、エレンは半分開いた目で見ます。
vocab.exampleEn: From the direction of the wall, different wings come down. The speed of the descent is not a recruit's way of flying. It is not. It is the Survey Corps. At the front of the Survey Corps is a short soldier. The short soldier's blade pulls through Titan napes almost without stopping. Eren watches the movement with half-open eyes. The movement he watches is the real thing of the wings he admired in front of the gate three years ago. The real thing is not a return with applause. It is a blade for clearing this street now.

vocab.exampleEn: After the failure, Mikasa leaves Eren with the squad at her back and goes to the front herself. The reason she goes is to postpone the mystery of the left arm inside the fight. vocab.exampleJa: 手放さない腕が、欠けた左腕の隣にあります。
vocab.exampleEn: Levi looks at Eren's face once and postpones questions. The reason he postpones them is that the road comes first now. His squad mows both sides of the road that is first. While they mow, Mikasa tries to match her own speed to Levi's. She admits the gap she cannot quite match. Admitting it wounds the pride of first place. Even wounded, she does not let go of Eren's position. The arm that does not let go is beside the missing left arm.
